title: Gate: shard long queued test binaries by libtest --list names in xtask

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
In `xtask/src/budget.rs` and `xtask/src/queue.rs`, a 16-core gate run uses `lane_limit(16) = 8` lanes and `per_lane(16, 8) = 2` (`--test-threads=2`).
Every queued step stays locked to 2 threads, even when the other 7 lanes sit idle.

Splitting long binaries into more `crates/*/tests/*.rs` files has a high cost:
- `crates/app/tests/` already has 542 binaries (median 82.6 MB debug, up to 134 MB for `shared_face_bodies_finish`; 24-53 MB release).
- `camcraft-motion --lib` cannot move its slow unit tests into `tests/*.rs`. All seven slow files import private `pub(super)` or `#[cfg(test)]` hooks (`OPEN_INSET`, `PEAK`, `PEAK_LEN`, `plan_from_air`, `cut_lane`, `plan_all_lanes`, `hsm_passes`).

What to do:
1. After the `--no-run` prebuild in `xtask`, locate the compiled binary for each queued step whose `timings.tsv` duration exceeds a threshold (for example 120 s).
2. Run `<exe> --list` (with `--ignored` for heavy steps) to collect the exact test names. This captures macro-generated tests such as `band!` in `shared_face_bodies_finish.rs` that regex-based `scan::test_fns` misses.
3. Partition the test names into shards and enqueue each shard with `--exact <names...>`.
4. Use one test per shard for heavy binaries with few tests. For large targets, keep each shard command line under 16 KB for Windows's 32 KB `CreateProcessW` cap (`camcraft-motion --lib` active names total 35,086 chars).
5. Name shards `<step name> [k/n]`. This keeps `select::name_matches` (`--only "<step name>"`), `--failed`, and `lanes::target_key` (`ISOLATED`) working cleanly.
6. Sum `<step name> [k/n]` durations by base step name when reading `timings.tsv` so sharded binaries stay sharded on later runs.
7. Order individual shards longest-first from their own `timings.tsv` rows.
8. Assert in `xtask` that the union of shard test names equals `<exe> --list` with zero missing or duplicate tests.

Done means:
- Multi-test heavy binaries fan out across all available release-gate lanes with zero new `tests/*.rs` binaries and zero Gate-map changes.
- `xtask` unit tests pin `--list` union coverage, command-line length bounds, and `timings.tsv` aggregation.
- `cargo test -p xtask` and `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` pass.

Part of #2556
